meta.name: obsidian-markdown
meta.description: Create and edit Obsidian Flavored Markdown with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, and other Obsidian-specific syntax. Use when working with .md files in Obsidian, or when the user mentions wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, tags, embeds, or Obsidian notes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编辑 Obsidian 专属 Markdown 语法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Obsidian 写笔记，需要处理 wikilink、callout 等特殊语法。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for notes and need to handle wikilinks, callouts, etc.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Obsidian 的专属语法来写笔记：包括笔记间双链、嵌入文件、提示框、属性等格式，并保证在 Obsidian 中能正常显示。
howto.when: 当你在 Obsidian 中处理 .md 文件，或提到 wikilinks、callouts、frontmatter 等 Obsidian 相关词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇笔记加上提示框，突出截止日期。
say.note: 会在笔记中插入 Obsidian 的提示框语法。

say.text: 用双链把这几篇笔记互相链接。
say.note: 笔记间会生成内部链接。

say.text: 给笔记添加 LaTeX 公式和 Mermaid 图表。
say.note: 会生成可渲染的公式和流程图。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can create and edit notes in Obsidian Flavored Markdown, including wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, and other Obsidian-specific syntax, ensuring they work in Obsidian.
howto.when_en: Triggers when working with .md files in Obsidian, or when the user mentions wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, or other Obsidian-related terms.

say_en.text: Add a callout to this note to highlight the deadline.
say_en.note: Inserts a callout using Obsidian syntax.

say_en.text: Link these notes together with wikilinks.
Add a LaTeX formula and a Mermaid diagram to the note.
say_en.note: Generates formulas and flowcharts that render.
